interpretation: Execution PASS is not profitability or historical market certification. Empty CSV values mean unavailable, never zero. Returns are on all funded capital; unknown terminal NAV withholds return. Drawdown is sampled and may omit unknown periods. INCOMPLETE means a recorded attempt lacks a final receipt; these snapshot counts do not prove process liveness. No annualization or regime selection is inferred.
